common.resolution: formal: 1 mm particles, 4 mm grid, 0.1 ms material dt, 20 ms control dt, seed 42, kinematic ideal tracking (no robot)
common.material: provisional, uncalibrated task material: E = 50 kPa, nu = 0.3, von Mises yield 1 kPa, no hardening, contact friction 0.3
always_report: component masses and recorded total mass vs sampler mass
common.mass_conservation: recorded mass equals the task sampler mass within the frozen v1 tolerance (pass condition)
common.runner: scripts/run_phase_f_v2_material.py (reuses scripts/run_phase_f_material.py read-only; no phaseF_v1 row changes)

F2.9_blunt_handle_v2.setup: CUT-03-K2 geometry (bar 160 x 30 x 20 mm on two friction-only pedestals, right pedestal x = 20..90 mm), armed, law 8, ruler_knife_v2_y. The v2 grip (the blunt handle box from the same ToolProfile: tool_profile.handle_box_edge, the obstacle box the runner already uses) presses -z onto the bar TOP with its far end face (edge-frame -y face, 24 x 22 mm), centred at local (x, y) = (55, 0) mm over the right pedestal centre, so the footprint x = 43..67 mm lies inside the pedestal span (20..90 mm) and the bar (x <= 80 mm), y = -11..11 mm inside the bar width (+/-15 mm). Orientation: edge-frame +x (advance) = local +x, edge line +y = local +z, blade normal +z = local -y, so the whole blade extends UPWARD from the grip (blade lowest point 60 mm above the grip face).
F2.9_blunt_handle_v2.plan: lift (disarmed, start orientation) to edge z = bar top + 15 mm grip gap + 120 mm; reorient + move over the footprint (disarmed, same height); lower_outside to a 3 mm grip gap (disarmed); handle_press: armed -z at 10 mm/s by 5 mm, ending 2 mm into the bar top; handle_hold: armed 0.3 s; retract (disarmed) to the travel height.

force_estimate.contact_area_note: handle far face 24 mm (edge x) x 22 mm (edge z), fully on the bar top
force_estimate.yield_confined_punch_formula: (2 + pi) / sqrt(3) * sigma_y * A (Prandtl punch, rigid-perfectly-plastic upper estimate)
force_estimate.support_note: the right pedestal reacts the press directly below the footprint; the press (< bar weight) cannot lift or yaw the bar

prediction.statement: Once the grip is more than ~0.4 mm into the top the load is yield-limited at about 0.5-1.6 N and stays there through the hold; the contact-window mean (ramp steps included) is 0.35-1.6 N, i.e. at least 3.5x the 0.1 N criterion. Rigid motion of the bar during press/hold: |COM displacement| < 0.2 mm and yaw < 0.1 deg; compression under the grip (bottom minus top layer z displacement) 1-2 mm, at least 5x the rigid displacement. Zero labels (only the blunt box touches material). Prediction is report-only; it is not a pass criterion.

blade_clearance_check.statement: The blade edge and faces must not touch the material. Static check before the run (CPU test on the ideal-integrated plan): minimum distance from the sampled blade prism (tool_profile.blade_mesh_edge) to the reference bar box > 5 mm on every step, >= 50 mm during handle_press / handle_hold; the grip box does not touch the bar before handle_press. Formal run: blade contact steps (contact_statistics[1] > 0) must be 0 on every control step of the episode.
blade_clearance_check.rule: control validity: a run with blade contact steps > 0 is INVALID_CONTROL and not PASS, whatever the criteria

F2.9_blunt_handle_v2.pass: zero new labels (labelled count 0 on every step); one component (stencil graph, final); mean |grip obstacle force| over handle_press / handle_hold steps with grip contact > 0.1 N (contact window, unchanged from v1); mass conserved
report_only: workpiece rigid displacement vs compression (mass-weighted rigid fit of all particles: COM displacement, rotation and yaw, residual; z-displacement of the top and bottom particle layers under the footprint; compression and strain), baseline = last history frame before handle_press and the reference configuration
blade and grip minimum clearance to the reference bar box along the recorded edge poses
